title: Point a note on a detached child's old ref at its new ref instead of refusing with a misleading work_claim_mismatch
outcome: Point a note on a detached child's old ref at its new ref instead of refusing with a misleading work_claim_mismatch
acceptance: After an optional child is detached into a new independent item, a note (or other late write) aimed at the child's OLD ref is refused with a reason that names the detachment and the new ref (for example 'detached into w-NEW; write to that item'), not with work_claim_mismatch's 'claim authority … is stale or does not match the holder'

A behaviour test detaches a child, then notes the old ref, and checks the refusal names the new ref and that nothing was written to either item; ordinary claim-mismatch refusals on non-detached items are unchanged
